column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline-scan rule overrides for WEX Purchase FX.
# Tuned for a JSON API service with no UI; baseline scan defaults assume an HTML
# app and flag things that don't apply (e.g., CSP on a JSON-only endpoint).

column3: (Incomplete or No Cache-control Header) — JSON endpoint; cache-control is set per RFC 9111 on the response
(Missing Anti-clickjacking Header) — no HTML responses; clickjacking N/A
(CSP Header Not Set) — no HTML responses; CSP N/A for JSON-only API
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set) — JSON-only API; Permissions-Policy N/A
(Timestamp Disclosure - Unix) — server's correlation-id contains a timestamp by design (RFC 4122 UUID v7)
(Modern Web Application) — single-page check; service is JSON API
